title: [BUG] Error while referencing file, claude damaged now
body: ## Environment - Platform (select one): - [X] Anthropic Subscription - Claude CLI version: 1.0.43 (Claude Code) - Operating System: Windows WSL with Ubuntu 24 - Terminal: Windows Terminal ## Bug Description While typing a prompt in a new claude windows and referencing a file, there was an error shown on the console. The error appeared randomly while typing. After that claude was damaged. Before that error occured, I randomly needed to sign in and all settings were reset, except for one mcp server. A complete WSL restart fixed the issue though. ## Steps to Reproduce I don't know how. ## Expected Behavior Claude works ## Actual Behavior Error occured ## Additional Context
author: prodigy
